reserveReview.rationale: On-chain read on 2026-07-30 via the public XPR Network Antelope API (chain_id 384da888112027f0321850a169f737c33e53b388aad48b5adace4bab97f437e0, head block 395509206, head_block_time 2026-07-30T20:22:35 UTC): the xmd.treasury account holds 2,276,317.826021 XUSDC, 100,000.000000 MPD, 0.000072 XPAX, and 0.000013 XPYUSD against an xmd.token stat supply of 2,376,317.765957 XMD (backing ratio ~1.00000003). Weights are computed against the total treasury balance of 2,376,317.826106 basket units: XUSDC 95.791809% and MPD 4.208191%; the XPAX and XPYUSD residuals are dust below 0.000000004% each and are documented here rather than allocated as slices. Issuer disclosures (XPR Network help center, metallicus.com, metaldollar.com) describe a USDC, PYUSD, and USDP/XPAX basket with 1:1 mint and redeem; none of them mention MPD, which the on-chain xmd.treasury tokens whitelist includes at a 2% maxTreasuryPercent cap (contract mpd.token, controlled by the same swapscold 2-of-4 Metallicus multisig, with a pausempd action and no public backing disclosure). XUSDC, XPYUSD, and XPAX are xtokens bridge wrappers whose upstream assets are Circle USDC and Paxos PYUSD/USDP.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: On-chain xmd.treasury account balances read via the XPR Network Antelope API at head block 395509206 (2026-07-30)
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Treasury balances and weights are fully measured on-chain, but the MPD slice (4.208191%) has no public backing disclosure and appears in no issuer documentation; the upstream bridge reserves backing the xtokens wrappers and any off-chain custody arrangements are not published, and no dated independent attestation exists.
